summary.en-US: Clear your browsing data in one click, and keep the sites that matter. No account, no analytics, no ads.
summary.zh-TW: 一鍵清除瀏覽資料，並保留重要的網站。沒有帳號、沒有分析追蹤、沒有廣告。

description.en-US:
Sweep clears your browsing data from one small popup. Pick a time range, pick what to clear, press Clean.

**What it clears**
Browsing history, download history, cache, form data, cookies, local storage, IndexedDB, service workers and saved passwords. A dot on each item shows whether it has something to clear.

**Keep what matters**
- Keep lists: for history, downloads and cookies, choose the sites that are never cleared. Open the magnifier on an item and switch a site on.
- Cookie whitelist: list the sites you trust and their cookies are left alone. The list can be switched off and on without losing it.

**Clean automatically**
Switch on "Clean automatically when the browser closes" and Sweep clears the selected items for you. A browser exits before an extension can finish, so the cleaning is completed the next time the browser starts.

**Check for browser updates (optional, off by default)**
If you switch it on, Sweep reads Mozilla's public list of Firefox releases, at most once every 6 hours, and shows a badge when your Firefox is out of date. This is the only time Sweep uses the network, and it sends nothing about you.

**Privacy**
Sweep has no account, no analytics and no ads. Your settings stay on your computer. It reads your browsing history and download history for three things: to show the "has data" dot, to list the sites you can choose to keep, and to remove entries while leaving the kept sites. None of it is sent anywhere.

**Good to know**
Firefox only lets extensions clear local storage, IndexedDB and service workers for all time, so those items are offered with the "All" time range only.

Available in English and Traditional Chinese, with light and dark themes. Sweep is open source under the MIT licence.
description.zh-TW:
Sweep 用一個小小的彈出視窗清除你的瀏覽資料。選時間範圍、選要清除的項目，按下「清除」就完成。

**可以清除的資料**
瀏覽紀錄、下載紀錄、快取、表單資料、Cookie、本機儲存空間、IndexedDB、Service Worker 和已儲存的密碼。每個項目上的圓點會告訴你那裡有沒有資料可以清。

**保留重要的資料**
- 保留清單：瀏覽紀錄、下載紀錄和 Cookie 都可以選擇永遠不清除的網站。點項目上的放大鏡，打開網站的開關即可。
- Cookie 白名單：列出你信任的網站，它們的 Cookie 不會被清除。白名單可以暫時關閉，清單不會消失。

**自動清除**
打開「關閉瀏覽器時自動清除」，Sweep 會替你清除選取的項目。瀏覽器會在擴充功能完成前就結束，所以清除會在下次啟動瀏覽器時完成。

**檢查瀏覽器更新（選用，預設關閉）**
打開之後，Sweep 會讀取 Mozilla 公開的 Firefox 版本清單（最多每 6 小時一次），你的 Firefox 過舊時顯示徽章。這是 Sweep 唯一會連網的時候，不會傳送任何關於你的資料。

**隱私**
Sweep 沒有帳號、沒有分析追蹤、沒有廣告，設定只存在你的電腦上。它讀取瀏覽紀錄和下載紀錄有三個用途：顯示「有資料可清除」的圓點、列出你可以選擇保留的網站、在清除時留下保留的網站。這些資料不會傳送到任何地方。

**使用須知**
Firefox 只允許擴充功能清除「全部時間」的本機儲存空間、IndexedDB 和 Service Worker，所以這幾項只在時間範圍選「全部」時提供。

提供英文和繁體中文介面，支援淺色與深色主題。Sweep 以 MIT 授權開放原始碼。

version.approval_notes:
The code is not minified, bundled or generated: the files in the package are the source files, copied as they are. Source: https://github.com/weehong-1/sweep (src/ plus manifest.firefox.json; build.ps1 only copies files).

No remote code. The only network request is the optional update check (off by default), a GET to https://product-details.mozilla.org/1.0/firefox_versions.json that sends no user data; see src/update.js.

Optional permissions 'cookies' and <all_urls> are requested only when the user switches on the cookie whitelist or keeps cookies for some sites. They are used to list which hosts have cookies so the other hosts can be passed to browsingData.remove (Firefox has no exclude list). Cookie values are not read.

'history' and 'downloads' are used to show whether there is something to clear, to list sites in a keep list, and to remove entries one by one while leaving the kept sites.

To test: open the popup, pick a time range, press Clean. No account is needed.
